parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outside frame of a door set, typically made of aluminum for structural support and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and alignment for the door panels, ensuring smooth operation and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame itself is fixed and does not move; it serves as the stationary boundary for the door panels.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main door panel of the door set, likely made of wood for aesthetic and functional purposes.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the movable barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: The door can swing or slide depending on the hinge or track mechanism, allowing controlled movement for entry and exit.
